profile_text.body:
Obsidian is a for-profit startup founded in 2020 and headquartered in Los Angeles, California, that makes a note-taking and personal knowledge management application. The company describes its product as a free and flexible app for private thoughts, emphasizing that notes are stored locally on the user's device, accessible offline, and unreadable by anyone other than the user. The application supports use cases ranging from personal journaling and knowledge bases to project management, and it allows users to link notes together, visualize relationships through an interactive graph, and work on an open-ended canvas for brainstorming and diagramming.

Obsidian's AI-related product, tracked under the category of Notes, Knowledge and Meetings, is characterized as a local-first knowledge AI that is privacy-focused and carries no cloud dependency. The platform supports thousands of plugins and an open API, which extends to AI integrations. Two MCP servers associated with Obsidian appear in the registry: one connects AI assistants to a GitHub-hosted Obsidian vault for access, search, and analysis, and another enables searching a vault to find notes by title or keyword and summarize related content. No litigation or SEC filings are recorded in the held facts.
